subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should deterministic MemoryIndexManager proof be accepted for this recovery PR, or should live Gateway/provider outage proof remain required before merge?
rationale: The patch looks bounded and well tested, but the repository’s real-behavior proof gate for external PRs is not satisfied by mocked provider tests, and only a maintainer can override that proof requirement.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Gateway memory_search run or logs showing primary outage, fallback activation, primary recovery, and restored search results before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the deterministic manager-level regression as sufficient if live provider outage infrastructure is unavailable.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmergeable until either proof is added or a maintainer-sponsored replacement supplies equivalent proof.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Gateway memory_search run or logs showing primary outage, fallback activation, primary recovery, and restored search results before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest provider-state helper history among the likely owners and is the best available owner for a proof-sufficiency decision on this memory-core boundary.
